These synthetic workbooks were generated independently with ExcelJS 4.4.0.
Both contain a Customers sheet with a header, a blank row, a leading-zero TIN,
rich text, a cached formula, a boolean, an external hyperlink with displayed
text, and a date (2026-10-08 12:30 UTC). One uses the 1900 date system and the
other the 1904 date system. No real customer data is included.

The committed files let the package's tests run without installing ExcelJS.
